The '''Western Jungle Expanse''' was the name given to the stretch of jungle on the western end of [[Horizon Island]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. Hills and canyons such as [[Skyline River Pass]] and [[Gorge Hollow River Pass]] formed a barrier between the jungle and the nearby town of [[Raider's Cove]] to the east. The [[Nova Blades]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang, made their headquarters in the crashed [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Aggressor (Rishi)|''Aggressor'']] that lay in the western mountains of the island. [[Shaclaw]]s, known locally as shore crabs, were common along the beaches, and the jungle was filled with [[tonitran]] lizards, [[jungle wampa]]s, [[krak'jya]]s, and [[Orobird/Legends|orobirds]].<ref name="TOR" />
